name: Kitasaki Yuuka
source:
Housewife, married for 3 years. She has a son. She meets the protagonist on a trip with her friend Tomoko, arranged by her husband.

She is a serious but easily swayed person. She is very weak with alcohol, and almost had a one night stand at a class reunion because of it.

She's troubled by the lack of sex in her marriage.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=975642&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
